artworks.title: Mrs. Graham
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is positioned at an angle, looking to the right. She has delicate facial features, a smooth complexion, and gentle eyebrows over thoughtful eyes. Her hair is styled intricately, and she wears a decorative headpiece. She is dressed in an elegant gown with lace details, and her arms are crossed, with her left hand holding onto some drapery. The gown has a pattern and is made from a luxurious fabric, possibly silk. A brooch or pendant is at the center of her chest. The background shows trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Elena Grimaldi
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a full-body view. The person in the foreground is standing and gazing slightly to the left. She has a calm expression with well-defined facial features and wears her hair pulled back and decorated with a headpiece. Her clothing is an elaborate long coat with intricate detailing and fur cuffs. She also wears a collar with ruffled lace and holds a small bouquet of flowers in her left hand. She holds a large, ornate parasol above her head, shielding her from above. Positioned slightly behind her is another person holding the parasol handle and leaning forward, wearing a loose-fitting garment. The background features architectural elements such as stone columns and a balustrade, with a landscape of rolling hills under a dramatic sky with thick, swirling clouds. The setting suggests an outdoor scene adjacent to a grand structure.

artworks.title: Dr. Pasteur
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up in a laboratory. He is holding a glass flask and inspecting it closely, with his gaze directed downwards. The man has a robust facial structure, neatly trimmed beard and mustache, and slicked back hair. He is wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and bow tie. The laboratory is filled with scientific apparatus, including flasks, bottles, and a microscope on a wooden tabletop. A shelf behind him is lined with glassware and equipment. The background is shadowy, creating a tranquil yet studious ambiance.

artworks.title: Rembrandt
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the upper body up. The individual is turned slightly to the right and looking straight ahead. They have distinct facial features including a prominent nose and a moustache. The person has curly medium length hair, partly covered by a textured cap. They are dressed in a detailed garment with a wide pleated collar and a robe with intricate designs on the shoulders. The background is a plain, neutral tone. The signature at the bottom right reads "T. Cole sc.1921, Timothy Cole."

artworks.title: Philemon and Baucis
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dimly lit interior scene. The drawing depicts a rustic interior with a simple wooden table. There is dim lighting casting shadows across the room. A figure is seated at the table, and there are other indistinct figures nearby. The room is sparsely furnished, with visible ceiling beams and a possible hearth or chimney on the left. The overall ambiance is intimate and shadowy, capturing quiet moments in the indoor space. The use of shading and contrast adds depth and a sense of warmth to the scene.

artworks.title: Philemon and Baucis
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dimly lit interior scene with people gathered around a table. A person is being focused on at the end of the table. A lamp or light source on the table illuminates the scene, highlighting faces and parts of the table with shadows. The background features dark wooden beams and rough textures. The drawing creates an atmosphere of intimacy and quiet within the space.

artworks.title: Rodin
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole after John Singer Sargent
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicting the upper half of his body, including his head and torso. The man has a long, full beard and a mustache. He seems to be sitting or standing straightforwardly and looking slightly to the side. His hair is neatly combed, and a few strands fall over his forehead. He is wearing a coat or outer garment that drapes over his shoulders. The background is plain and textured, with no visible objects or scenery around him.

artworks.title: Thomas Jefferson
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man seated at a table. He is facing toward the viewer's left with a calm expression. He has white hair styled in soft curls, and he is wearing a dark coat with a white cravat around his neck. The man holds a quill pen in his right hand over a piece of paper, with his left hand resting on his knee. In the background, there is a large cylindrical column and a draped curtain. The scene is monochromatic and finely detailed.

artworks.title: Washington
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a chest-up portrait. He faces forward with a composed expression. The man has white hair in a powdered wig, dressed in dark formal attire with a high collar and a white ruffled cravat. The background is dark, emphasizing the subject.

artworks.title: Mary Cassatt at the Louvre: The Paintings Gallery
artworks.medium: etching, soft-ground etching, aquatint, and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows the back view of a person standing in front of a wall with framed artworks. They have short, curly hair and wear a long-sleeved dress. The person holds an umbrella in their right hand and a closed book in their left arm. The background features textured walls with designs and two large framed pictures. The floor is wooden.

artworks.title: Mademoiselle Bécat at the Cafe des Ambassadeurs (Aux Ambassadeurs: Mlle Bécat)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with her arms outstretched, palms open. Her facial features are subtly portrayed. She has styled hair and wears a dress with a fitted bodice and detailed sleeves. The background features a window with fireworks outside, a chandelier, and decorative elements or mirrors to the sides. The overall tone is dark and dramatic.

artworks.title: The Engraver Joseph Tourny (Le graveur Joseph Tourny)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man sitting down with his arms on a surface. He is looking directly ahead. His face appears detailed with distinct features, wearing a cap and a loose garment with folded sleeves. The background is simple, suggesting a window or door frame, with horizontal lines for texture. In the lower portion, there is a smaller, upside-down sketch of a person's head done in fine lines and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Marguerite De Gas, the Artist's Sister (Marguerite De Gas, soeur de l'artiste)
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person focusing primarily on their upper body. The individual is facing forward with their face resting on their left hand. Their facial features include wide eyes, a defined nose, and a slightly parted mouth, framed by short, wavy hair covered with a bonnet or headwear. They are wearing a garment with a high collar and possibly a shawl or draped fabric around the shoulders. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held. The background consists of a densely hatched texture.

artworks.title: After the Bath (La sortie du bain (Grand planche))
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of a person's upper body, focusing on their back and shoulders. The individual is positioned with their back slightly turned and head bent forward. Their facial features are not clearly visible due to the angle and shading, with long hair cascading down to partially obscure their face. The person's clothing is not distinctly detailed, and there is no visible jewelry or objects in their hands. Surrounding the figure is a textured shading, with a cluster of floral motifs or abstracted shapes in the upper background.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms of Lorenz Staiber
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic crest. It features a coat of arms with a shield at the center. The shield has two quadrants: the upper quadrant displays a lion and a rope, and the lower quadrant shows a dog. Above the shield is a crown-like structure with a crowned lion holding two flags. Surrounding the central arrangement are scrollwork and decorative elements. The text below the image reads, "Omnia ex Deo veniunt," which means "All things come from God." The drawing is in monochrome, highlighting the linework and shading.

artworks.title: Gabriel Cortois de Pressigny
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing in a slightly turned position with his head facing forward. He has distinct facial features, including a defined nose and relaxed expression. His hair is light and combed back gently. He is dressed in ornate clerical attire with intricate patterns on his sleeves and collar, and wears a large cross around his neck. His right hand rests on a document, while his left hand holds a book or similar object, resting on a table. The background is plain, with no additional details.

artworks.title: Odalisque
artworks.description: The image shows a woman reclining on a couch or bed. She is lying on her side with her upper torso supported by her left arm, and her legs are outstretched. She has an oval-shaped face, delicate features, and her hair is partially covered by a headscarf. The woman is unclothed, wearing only a bracelet and an anklet on her left wrist and ankle. The setting includes ornate textiles on the furniture and a detailed rug underneath. Heavy drapery hangs on one side, and there is a decorative incense burner nearby. The background consists of patterned fabric.

artworks.title: Holy Family and Four Saints
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in yellow, green-gray, dark brown, and dark-gray on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals engaged in a scene that appears to have religious significance. In the center, a woman is seated on a raised platform, holding a small child on her lap. The woman has long hair and delicate facial features, adorned in flowing robes. The child has curly hair and is depicted holding an object in each hand. Surrounding them are four other figures. To the left stands a winged figure with short hair, draped in a voluminous cloak, extending their hands toward the central figures. Another individual, bearded and dressed in layered garments, tends to the child, while another kneels with a contemplative expression. To the right, an elderly man holding a staff, wearing a long robe, gazes next to the central woman. Behind this assembly is a detailed backdrop featuring ornate patterns and architectural details, such as columns and drapery.

artworks.title: Vestiges d'un temple de la Grece
artworks.artist: Jean-François Janinet after Giovanni Paolo Panini
artworks.description: The image depicts ancient ruins with human figures. The foreground shows people interacting near classical architecture, including columns with Corinthian capitals. There is a fractured entablature and a circular stone piece nearby. A decorated urn stands on the right. The background blends the sky and distant landscape. The painting focuses on details in the architecture, figures' clothing, and classical style. The color palette consists of browns, beiges, greys, pale blues, and hints of green.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures in a classical composition. A young nude child reaches towards a woman in flowing drapery, who gazes down at the child. Another woman holds the child, while a second child stands nearby holding a small cross. An angelic figure hovers above with wings, presenting a bouquet. In the background, an older man sits with an introspective expression. The setting is majestic, with draped fabric suggesting an interior space, rendered in a soft monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Edouard Gautier d'Agoty
artworks.artist: Carlo Lasinio after Johann Ernst Heinsius
artworks.description: The image features a person sitting in a three-quarter position, facing slightly to the right and looking at the viewer. The individual has light skin and curly light-colored hair under a wide-brimmed brown hat. They wear a brown coat over a white shirt with a distinctive collar. The person holds quills in one hand. The background is a muted greenish tone with a textured appearance, and there is no visible jewelry on the person.

artworks.title: Lucy Lawrence
artworks.artist: Frederick Christian Lewis I after Sir Thomas Lawrence
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in period attire, seated and facing the viewer. She has expressive eyes, curly dark hair, and is wearing a bonnet and a shawl. The background is plain with subtle shading, and there is handwritten text around the edges.

artworks.title: The Virgin Seated under a Tree
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman with a child on her lap, leaning against a tree trunk. The woman wears a full-length dress with long sleeves and high neckline. The child is nude and has curly hair. The background includes a tree branch, grass, rocks, and vegetation. The illustration is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Saint George Liberating the Princess
artworks.description: This is a illustration of two figures with horses in a forest. One figure on the left wears a flowing garment and a headdress while interacting with another figure dressed as a traveler or soldier. In the background, there is a person on horseback wearing armor and holding a flag or spear. The image is detailed with fine lines, focusing on textures and details like clothing, horse muscles, and tree bark. The background shows rugged terrain, hinting at narrative depth.
